rationale: Two artifact-only conditions pass the diagnostic rule under changed execution with four and sixteen episodes; twelve neighboring maximum-label evidence-tier conditions fail. Admit exactly their fourteen second registered fits to test whether these gains, failures and native-to-shift changes persist under a different training draw. These are nonprimary comparisons and matched neighbors of the previously frozen context candidate, not new independent worlds or confirmation. The panel is predeclared in the immutable forest; average fits inside whole worlds. Native primary failures and the frozen confirmation extension remain separate. No setting, criterion, lineage or seed is added. Measured useful demand has fallen below one day, and these warranted counterparts restore it without repeating valid jobs.
